_comment: NPC dialogue for elder_fenwick (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Elder Fenwick
1.text: Fenwick of Oakstead sent word: the mill road is no longer safe, and the village wants a sword arm to walk it.

2.speaker: Elder Fenwick
2.text: Reach Visited Oakstead. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Elder Fenwick
1.text: The wolves have stopped hunting deer and started hunting pens.

2.speaker: Elder Fenwick
2.text: Slay 5 Meadow Wolf. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Elder Fenwick
1.text: Oakstead's fever wants cave moss, and the caves are full of things that want it too.

2.speaker: Elder Fenwick
2.text: Gather 4 Cave Moss. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Elder Fenwick
1.text: Oakstead rebuilt the fold where the wolves came through. Fenwick wants the pack that did it thinned to nothing.

2.speaker: Elder Fenwick
2.text: Slay 8 Meadow Wolf. Come back to me when it is done.

barks.text: Oakstead was a mill before it was a village. We still grind what we can.
The Meadows feed the Barrens. Nobody south of the ridge remembers that.
My grandmother planted that oak. It has outlived better people than me.
